scope: Production verifyEffect with safe synthetic Data views and the actual Img4tool IM4P / IMG4 decoding APIs; no VM, mount or AMFI operations.
symptom: Component receipt: required effect absent from final output: kernel.apfs_root_snapshot
red_result: Three payloads equal their original zero-indexed byte data but retain startIndex 17 / 31 / 41; each valid relative offset 128 is falsely rejected by verifyEffect. Reproduced twice before production edit.
confirmed_cause: PatchRecord.fileOffset is relative to the payload. Data.subdata(in:) takes collection indices; using fileOffset directly selects wrong bytes in a nonzero-startIndex Data view.
fix: Preserve nonnegative, nonempty and subtraction-based bounds checks, then calculate start and end using Data.index from payload.startIndex; compare a zero-copy slice.
